audit_metadata.grade_rationale: 4 P1 findings exceed C-grade threshold of max_p1=2. 12 P2 findings. Full spec coverage 27% (below C threshold of 40%). Both metrics independently place this audit at grade D.

escalations.title: Handlebars Multiple JavaScript Injection Vulnerabilities
escalations.reason: Arbitrary code execution via AST type confusion (CVSS 9.8) — injection trigger matches security escalation policy

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read and Execution
escalations.reason: Unauthenticated arbitrary file read and code execution (CVSS 9.8) — sensitive data exposed + code execution match security escalation policy

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution in Orchestrator
escalations.reason: Arbitrary code execution via untrusted .proto processing (CVSS 9.8) in orchestrator infrastructure — injection trigger matches security escalation policy
escalations.fix: npm update protobufjs to 7.6.3+ (may require dockerode@5.0.1+)

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search not registered — DependencyPicker broken at runtime
p1_findings.description: The search route required by FR-dependency-search is not wired in app.ts. The DependencyPicker component silently receives 404s and shows empty results — the entire dependency search UI is non-functional at runtime.
p1_findings.recommendation: Register GET /api/search in app.ts. Store findAll() already supports filtering; create src/routes/search.ts as a thin wrapper.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: User opens DependencyPicker, types a search query, gets empty results with no error. Feature appears to work but no data is ever returned.

p1_findings.title: Handlebars Multiple JavaScript Injection Vulnerabilities
p1_findings.recommendation: Update @babel/core transitive chain: npm update handlebars

p1_findings.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read and Execution
p1_findings.recommendation: Update vitest to 4.1.9+; disable --ui flag in CI scripts

p1_findings.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution in Orchestrator
p1_findings.recommendation: Update protobufjs to 7.6.3+ via dockerode@5.0.1+ in platform/orchestrator

p2_findings.title: Route handlers call store directly, bypassing service layer
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract workItemService.ts and intakeService.ts; move store calls out of route handlers

p2_findings.title: pending_dependencies status missing from enum; dispatch-gating deviates from spec
p2_findings.recommendation: Add PendingDependencies to WorkItemStatus enum and implement spec'd status-transition behavior, OR formally deviate in spec

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind spot: FR-dependency-* not tracked
p2_findings.recommendation: Add FR-dependency-* requirements to Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md; enforcer currently covers only 12% of all declared requirements

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-schema: in-memory arrays vs SQLite junction table
p2_findings.recommendation: Update spec to document in-memory approach as intentional, or implement junction table. Test traceability comments must not claim SQLite compliance.

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed: no seed data implemented
p2_findings.recommendation: Add src/seed.ts with spec'd seed relationships populated on startup (NODE_ENV !== 'test'), or defer requirement

p2_findings.title: Form-Data CRLF Injection
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update form-data to 4.0.6+ (auto-resolved via express/vite update)

p2_findings.title: Vite Path Traversal and server.fs.deny Bypass
p2_findings.recommendation: Update vite to 8.1.2+ in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

p2_findings.title: React Router Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URLs
p2_findings.recommendation: Update react-router-dom to 6.30.4+ or React Router v7

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp Regular Expression Denial of Service
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update path-to-regexp (transitive via express); update express to 5.x for full fix
p2_findings.cross_ref: QO-002 — route handler complexity compounds ReDoS surface

p2_findings.title: uuid Missing Buffer Bounds Check
p2_findings.recommendation: Bump uuid to 11.1.1+ or 14.0.1+ (major version required) in Source/Backend and portal/Backend

p2_findings.title: WebSocket Memory Exhaustion Denial of Service
p2_findings.recommendation: Update ws via vitest/vite update in Source/Frontend

p3_findings.title: Duplicate test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
eslint-disable suppresses react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in two production files
FR-001 to FR-069 in dev-workflow-platform.md untracked; scope boundary undocumented
FR-WF-013 workflow metrics not directly verified by any test
qs Query String DoS via TypeError
Express 4.x — 1 major version behind; missing 18 months of security patches
Missing lock files in Frontend, E2E, Orchestrator workspaces

p4_findings.title: High transitive dependency count in Source/Backend (411)
Single-maintainer packages (uuid, pino) — supply chain informational
License audit deferred — no license-checker run

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Route handler complexity — business logic, store calls, and HTTP mapping in single function
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Extract workItemService.ts; store calls via service layer. Path-to-regexp ReDoS surface is reduced because simpler handlers = fewer complex parameterized routes.
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves QO-002 (architecture violation) + reduces attack surface for DEP-008 (ReDoS)

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Dependency hygiene process gap — no audit policy in CI, no lock files, no version pinning
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Add npm audit --audit-level=high to CI gate; commit package-lock.json to all workspaces. The critical CVEs would have been caught immediately at install time.
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves DEP-018 (lock files) + creates ongoing detection for DEP-001/002/003 class of issues

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Spec traceability coverage gap — enforcer scope covers only 12% of declared requirements
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Expand traceability enforcer to include FR-dependency-* requirements. QO-001 (missing route) and QO-003 (enum gap) would both be caught by a properly-scoped enforcer.
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves QO-004 directly; makes QO-001 and QO-003 detectable by automated gate
